get_respiratory_snapshot.description:
Get the current respiratory activity snapshot for a jurisdiction.

Returns the latest week's levels for influenza, COVID-19, and/or RSV
across three signals: hospital admissions (NHSN), wastewater (NWSS),
and test positivity (NREVSS).

USE WHEN you want a quick overview of all pathogens and signals for one
location. Each signal includes the latest value, CDC official level (if
available), and a heuristic trend direction.

DO NOT use this tool for detailed weekly series or multi-season comparison
— use assess_trend or compare_to_prior_seasons instead.

Returns: jurisdiction, latest week-ending date, per-pathogen signal
readings, cross-signal concordance pattern, and caveats.

jurisdiction.description: US state code (e.g. 'GA'), territory (e.g. 'PR'), or 'USA'/'national'. Case-insensitive; common aliases accepted.

items.description: Respiratory pathogen: 'influenza', 'covid19', or 'rsv'. Aliases: 'flu' → influenza, 'covid'/'sars-cov-2' → covid19.

pathogens.description: Up to three unique pathogens; omit for all. Aliases flu and covid accepted.

as_of.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) to restrict analysis to data on or before this date. Omit to use the most recent available data. Applied to data retrieved now, not an as-published historical vintage. Use frozen snapshots for reproducible replay.

assess_trend.description:
Assess the recent trend for one respiratory signal in a jurisdiction.

Returns a weekly time series and a heuristic trend classification
(increasing / stable / decreasing / insufficient_data) for one
combination of jurisdiction, pathogen, and signal.

USE WHEN you want to characterise the direction of change for a specific
signal over recent weeks. Includes the weekly series so values can be cited.

DO NOT use for multi-pathogen overviews — use get_respiratory_snapshot.
DO NOT use for prior-season comparison — use compare_to_prior_seasons.

Returns: weekly series, trend direction, % change, provenance, and caveats.

compare_to_prior_seasons.description:
Compare current-season activity to prior seasons at the equivalent week.

Aligns the current week-of-season to the same week in up to 5 prior
seasons. Returns rank among available prior-week comparisons and percentage of
the prior peak.

USE WHEN you need historical context: Is this week worse than typical?
How does this week compare with available prior weeks and complete-season peaks?

DO NOT use for current-week levels or trend direction — use
get_respiratory_snapshot or assess_trend instead.

Returns: season comparison with prior-season data points, rank, % of
prior peak, provenance, and caveats.

find_jurisdictions_with_rising_activity.description:
Find rising states/DC for hospital admissions or wastewater.

USE WHEN comparing jurisdictions; use assess_trend for one location.
National-only test positivity cannot support a state scan. Fetches one
paginated query and reports assessed/missing counts, per-row provenance,
and caveats. min_level applies only to hospital admissions.
Results are descriptive heuristics, not validated outbreak predictions.
